## Risk trigger check

Mark Yes or No and explain briefly. Assess actual behavior and semantic spec
changes, not only file extensions. See
[review rule](https://github.com/dengwensha/MPC-Platform/blob/main/docs/reviews/Risk-Based-Senior-Review.md).

- Wire contract or serialization: Yes/No — reason
- Enum numeric values: Yes/No — reason
- Trust boundary or fail-closed rules: Yes/No — reason
- Interprocess communication: Yes/No — reason
- Persistence: Yes/No — reason
- UI entry into production code: Yes/No — reason

Any Yes requires independent Senior review before merge.
Reviewer / reviewed commit / findings disposition: pending or linked evidence.
All No: explain why standard review and CI suffice.

## Validation and remaining acceptance

Record exact commit/configuration, relevant build and full test/CI evidence,
remaining physical acceptance and open findings. Do not infer physical or
production suitability from controlled tests.
